text: M12 `ecawzsbr` (2.1.26) trims the `ask` profile in the `mcp` channel to "the common reads, plans with their writes and describe_entity_type", and defines the common reads as the read tools of the discovery core and the skills registry, list_projects and the release reads. Read literally, that leaves out the catalogued type-specific READS of plugin servers (e.g. `spreadsheet-tools · get_range`). But `4cli19xs` says type-specific tools are available to the external caller and that the only narrowing is the context profile, with the spreadsheet example: get_entities returns the skeleton and get_range the cells, "so an entity is never visible and empty at once" — which an `ask` connection without get_range would break. Built (implementer): `ask` keeps the catalogued plugin reads (the class-based gate admits a plugin tool declared `read`, fails closed on undeclared and write ones), as before; it carries no other read beyond the table's (every host read tool outside the table collides with a c4s-reader name and is shadowed). Needed from the spec: say whether the `ask` (and `chat`) rows include catalogued type-specific reads, e.g. by adding them to the common-reads sentence.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-2613 — `ask` keeps catalogued plugin (type-specific) reads in the mcp channel
